packageRules.description: Pin Docker image digests so a stale :latest can't drift into a GitHub-deprecated runner binary. TODO: promote pinDigests for Docker into jellyrock/.github//renovate/default once validated here; current org default only pins github-actions digests.

myoung34/github-runner bundles the GitHub Actions runner binary, which GitHub deprecates every 1-3 months; staying current prevents the deprecation restart-loop. Upstream rebuilds :latest more often than the org default's 2-day digest soak, so minimumReleaseAge NEVER resolves — Renovate re-targets the newer digest each run and resets the clock, so the bump never automerges. A soak is meaningless for a continuously-rebuilt rolling tag anyway (there's no discrete release to age), so we drop it (minimumReleaseAge:0) and instead gate automerge on the runner-image-smoke CI job, which actually pulls and runs the image. A weekly schedule rate-limits the churn to one digest/week (the runner self-updates its binary at container start, so weekly currency is ample).
